title: Fig's Big Plan
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new split digraphs o-e, u-e
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness), 94-sound stage (o-e, u-e just added).

pages.text: Fig has a big plan for a home.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar studying a gap between two leaves, looking thoughtful.

pages.text: Fig gets a leaf and a stem.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar gathering a few broad leaves and a thin plant stem.

pages.text: Fig sets the stem on top.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar laying the stem carefully across the top of the gap.
The stem sliding sideways and falling away from the gap.
Fig the caterpillar pausing, looking at the fallen stem with a new idea forming.

pages.text: Fig ties the stem with a leaf.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar wrapping a thin leaf strand around the stem to hold it in place.

pages.text: This time, the stem stays on.
pages.illustration: The stem staying firmly in place, tied securely with the leaf strand.

pages.text: Fig has a home at last.
pages.illustration: A small shelter formed from the leaves and tied stem, complete at last.

pages.text: Fig is proud of the home.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting beside his finished leafy shelter, looking proud.

pages.text: Fig naps in the new home.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sleeping peacefully inside his new leafy shelter.
